correctness.rationale: The claim is proved directly from the source coefficient-series equations. The root function is strictly increasing in r and strictly decreasing in alpha, and implicit differentiation gives rho_alpha'>0. The covering series satisfies T_alpha'=S_alpha, so its derivative along the root curve reduces to -partial_alpha T_alpha>0. The large-alpha root equation admits a uniform digamma decomposition, giving the exponential deficit, while an absolutely convergent inverse-alpha expansion of T_alpha(1) gives the stated covering coefficients. The difference between evaluation at rho_alpha and at 1 is exponentially small.

value.rationale: The differential parameter alpha defines a natural nested family and suppresses higher coefficients mode by mode. The result completely orders the recent Landau guarantees across that family and reveals two genuinely different stabilization mechanisms: exponential filling of the univalence disk and algebraic convergence of the covering radius. This is a structural parameter theorem rather than a routine evaluation at another fixed alpha.
